text:
lina.ae: Heads-up — Solstice Procurement paused their POC. They need a signed data-residency attestation + a firm pilot spend cap before legal will release the PO. Can Sec/Eng join a 20m sync today?

omar.presales: I can. Quick Q: do we have an attestation template Legal prefers or should Sec draft something short? Also: spend cap — weekly or total for 30 days?

nisha.sec: We have a one-pager template we can adapt: region guarantee, no outbound raw-data egress without approval, audit log retention. Need to know KMS preference (BYOK vs Redwood KMS) and whether they require HSM attestation.

ryan.eng: For Dedicated VPC pilot we can provision in ~72h. On-prem adds several weeks. Note: if they insist on a pinned model + quantized variant, we'll want a quick compatibility run against a sample set first.

beth.csm: Customer insists on a hard ceiling for the 30-day pilot. Procurement won't sign without a $ cap in writing. Finance needs to greenlight any figure.
omar.presales: Suggestion: 30-day pilot, Dedicated VPC, optional BYOK, pilot cap $5,000 total or $0.0008/token overage, whichever favors customer. Presenting as proposal — can Rev/Finance confirm?

nisha.sec: Draft attestation for Legal review:```
Data Residency Attestation (draft)
- Processing restricted to region: eu-central-1.
- No export of raw customer data outside region without customer authorization.
- Customer may use BYOK; Redwood supports customer-managed keys or Redwood KMS with HSM.
- Inference request audit logs retained for 90 days.
```

lina.ae: @ticket-bot please open an internal ticket to track approvals and owners.

ticket-bot: Created SD-4017 (Solstice POC board hold). Assigned: omar.presales, nisha.sec, legal-team.

ryan.eng: Reserving a staging Dedicated slot pending sign-off. If BYOK, start KMS onboarding (24-48h). I'll also schedule a 1-hour validation once beth uploads sanitized samples.

beth.csm: Uploading sanitized samples to secure share now and inviting Eng/Sec.

omar.presales: @finance please confirm the $5k cap or advise alternative ASAP so we can present to their execs.

nisha.sec: Legal asked to include an addendum: "Redwood will provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48 hours of request." Getting legal review now.

lina.ae: Plan: 1) Send draft attestation + pricing cap to customer today, 2) schedule 20-30m CTO/CISO call tomorrow with our execs, 3) run compatibility test once samples are in. Target: PO released by Fri EOD if Finance/Legal OK.

ticket-bot: SD-4017 status -> "awaiting legal review"

omar.presales: I'll prep a short SLA addendum in case procurement asks for uptime language.

beth.csm: Customer DM: on-prem only if audit requires; VPC ok for pilot. Sharing draft and proposing 11am or 3pm tomorrow.

lina.ae: Thanks all — please keep updates in SD-4017. If legal signs fast we can get exec intro same day.
